Phir farmate hain ki hum to isi khayal mein the ki jinn-o-ins Allah par jhoot nahi baandh sakein ge lekin Quran sun kar maloom hua ki yeh dono jama'atein Rab-ul-Alameen par tohamt rakhti thein, darasal Allah ki zaat is aib se paak hai. Phir kehte hain ki jinaat ke zyada behakne ka sabab yeh hua ki woh dekhte the ki insan jab kabhi kisi jangal ya weerane mein jate hain to jinaat ki panah talab kiya karte hain, jaise ki jahiliyat ke zamane ke Arab ki aadat thi ki jab kabhi kisi padaav par utarte to kehte ki is jangal ke bade jinn ki panah mein hum aate hain aur samajhte the ki aisa keh lene ke baad tamam jinaat ke shar se hum mehfooz ho jate hain, jis tarah kisi shahar mein jate to wahan ke bade raees ki panah le lete taaki shahar ke aur dushman log unhein eza na pahunchayein. Adab-e-Sajdah aur Jinnat ka Islam Lana

Allah Ta'ala apne bando ko hukm deta hai ke uski ibadat ki jagahon ko shirq se paak rakhein, wahan kisi doosre ka naam na pukaarein, na kisi aur ko Allah ki ibadat mein shareek karein. Hazrat Qatadah (Rahimahullah) farmate hain ke Yahood-o-Nasara apne garjon aur kanison mein ja kar Allah ke sath auron ko bhi shareek karte the, to is ummat ko hukm ho raha hai ke woh aisa na karein, balki Nabi bhi aur ummat sab tauheed wale rahein. Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain is ayat ke nuzool ke waqt sirf Masjid-e-Aqsa thi aur Masjid-e-Haram. Hazrat A'mash ne is ayat ki tafseer yeh bayan ki hai ke jinnat ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se ijazat chahi ke aap ki masjid mein aur insano ke sath namaz ada karein, goya unse kaha ja raha hai ke namaz padho lekin insano ke sath khalt-malṭ na ho. 

Hazrat Saeed bin Jubair (R.H) farmate hain jinno ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se kaha ke hum to door-daraaz rehte hain, namazo mein aap ki masjid mein kaise pahunch sakenge? To unhe kaha jata hai ke maqsood namaz ka ada karna aur sirf Allah hi ki ibadat baja lana hai, khwah kahin ho. Hazrat Ikrimah (R.H) farmate hain yeh ayat aam hai, is mein sabhi masajid shamil hain. 

Hazrat Saeed bin Jubair (R.H) farmate hain ke yeh ayat aza-e-sajdah ke bare mein nazil hui hai, yaani jin aza par tum sajdah karte ho woh sab Allah hi ke hain, pas tum par in aza se doosre ke liye sajdah karna haram hai. 

Sahih Hadees mein hai ke mujhe saat haddiyon par sajdah karne ka hukm kiya gaya hai: peshani aur hath ke isharay se naak ko bhi is mein shamil kar liya, aur dono hath, dono ghutne aur dono panjay.

Aayat (Lamma Qama) ka aik matlab toh yeh hai ke jinaat ne jab Huzoor ﷺ ki zubaani tilawat-e-Quran suni toh is tarah aage barh barh kar aqeedat ka izhaar karne lage ke goya aik doosre ke saron par charhe chale jaate hain, doosra matlab yeh hai ke jinaat apni kaum se keh rahe hain ke Huzoor ﷺ ke ashab ki ita’at aur chahat ki halat yeh hai ke jab Huzoor ﷺ namaz ko khare hote hain aur ashab peechhe hote hain toh barabar ita’at aur iqtida mein aakhir tak mashghool rehte hain goya aik halqa hai, teesra kaul yeh hai ke jab Rasool Allah ﷺ ki tauheed ka aalaan logon mein karte hain toh kafir log daant chaba chaba kar ulajh jaate hain, jinaat-o-insan mil jaate hain ke is amr-e-deen ko mita dein aur is ki roshni ko chhupa lein magar Allah ka irada is ke khilaf ho chuka hai, yeh teesra kaul hi zyada zahir maaloom hota hai kyunki is ke baad hi hai ke main to sirf apne Rab ka naam wird-e-zaban rakhta hoon aur kisi aur ki ibadat nahi karta, yaani jab dawat-e-haq aur tauheed ki aawaz un ke (Al-Ankabut:11) yaani Allah Ta'ala iman walon ko aur munafiqon ko barabar jaan lega aur bhi is qisam ki aayatein hain matlab yeh hai ki Allah pehle hi se jaanta hai lekin use zahir kar ke bhi jaan leta hai, isi liye yahan is ke baad hi farmaya ki har cheez aur sab ki ginti Allah ke ilm ke ihata mein hai. Alhamdulillah Surah Jinn ki tafsir khatam hui.)

Allah ke siva Qiyamat kab hogi kisi ko nahin maloom. Allah Ta'ala apne Rasool ﷺ ko hukm deta hai keh logon se keh dein keh Qiyamat kab hogi, is ka ilm mujhe nahin, balkeh main yeh bhi nahin janta keh is ka waqt qareeb hai ya door hai aur lambi muddat ke baad aane wali hai. Is ayat-e-karimah mein daleel hai is amr ki jo aksar jahilon mein mashhoor hai keh Huzoor ﷺ zameen ke andar ki cheezon ka bhi ilm rakhte hain, woh bilkul ghalat hai. Is riwayat ki koi asl nahin, mahz jhoot hai aur bilkul be-asl riwayat hai, hum ne to ise kisi kitab mein nahin paya. Haan is ke khilaf saaf sabit hai, Huzoor ﷺ se Qiyamat ke qaim hone ka waqt poocha jata tha aur aap is ke muayyan waqt se apni la-ilmi zahir karte the. Arabi ki soorat mein Hazrat Jibraeel A.S ne bhi aa kar jab Qiyamat ke bare mein sawal kiya tha to aap ne saaf farmaya tha keh is ka ilm nah poochne wale ko hai nah use jis se poocha ja raha hai. Aik aur hadees mein hai keh aik dihaat ke rehne wale ne ba-awaz-e-buland aap se دریافت kiya keh Huzoor ﷺ Qiyamat kab aaye gi? Aap ne farmaya woh aaye gi zaroor, magar yeh bata keh tu ne is ke liye kya taiyari kar rakhi hai? Us ne kaha mere paas roz-e-namaz ki aksariat to nahi, albatta Rasoolullah ﷺ ki muhabbat hai. Aap ne farmaya phir to tu us ke sath hoga jis ki tujhe muhabbat hai. Hazrat Anas R.H farmate hain musalman kisi hadees se is qadar khush nahin hue jitne is hadees se. Is hadees se bhi maloom hua keh Qiyamat ka theek waqt aap ko maloom nah tha. Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai keh aap ne farmaya: Ae logon! Agar tum mein ilm hai to apne tain murdon mein shumar kiya karo. Allah ki qasam jis ka tum se wada kiya jata hai woh yaqinan aik waqt aane wali hai. Yahan bhi aap koi muqarrara waqt nahin batate. Abu Dawood mein hai keh Allah Ta'ala is ummat ko kya ajab keh aadhe din tak ki mohlat de de, aur riwayat mein itna aur bhi hai keh Hazrat Sa'ad se poocha gaya keh aadhe din se kya murad hai? Farmaya: Paanch sau saal. Phir farmata hai Allah Alim-ul-Ghaib hai, woh apne ghaib par kisi ko muttala nahi karta magar mursaleen mein se jise chun le. Jaise aur jagah hai ayat (Wa la yuheetoona bishai-min 'ilmihi illa bima sha') (Surah (Al-Baqarah: 255), yani is ke ilm mein se kisi cheez ka ihata nahi kar sakte magar jo Allah chahe. Yani Rasool khwah insanon mein se hon khwah farishton mein se hon, jise Allah jitna chahta hai bata deta hai bas woh utna hi jaante hain. Phir is ki mazeed takhsees yeh hoti hai ke is ki hifazat aur sath hi is ilm ki ishaat ke liye jo Allah ne use diya hai us ke aas paas har waqt nigehban farishte muqarrar rehte hain.
